# Copilot Instructions

The agent and contributor instructions for this repository live in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root.

**Read `CLAUDE.md`** — it is the single source of truth for architecture, commands, conventions, change-verification, and safety constraints (including: never complete a purchase on Bandcamp).

Do not add guidance here; keeping it in one place prevents the two files from drifting out of sync.
